verdict.rationale: PostHog documents an official MCP server that lets agents run trends, funnels, retention, and HogQL/SQL queries directly (posthog-docs-2, posthog-docs-19, posthog-probe-4), plus a public REST/OpenAPI API (posthog-probe-3) and a data warehouse for cross-source SQL queries (posthog-docs-9). However, a hands-on community report describes the LLM-driven query feature failing to write correct SQL/cohort queries and causing severe client-side slowdowns (posthog-comm-8), suggesting real-world reliability gaps not reflected in the docs. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that MCP-driven growth-question answering works reliably at scale, and resolution of the reported query-generation/performance issues.
